buyer_question: How should buyers compare a China packaging supplier with a local packaging supplier before RFQ?
short_answer: Buyers should compare product fit, structure capability, sampling workflow, communication path, artwork readiness, sales channel, packing method and target-market document questions before choosing a supplier route. MUGE PACKAGING reviews supplier-fit questions as project-specific packaging briefs rather than country-based proof of price, timing, certification, production capacity or compliance.

review nearby sampling, local communication and whether technical packaging depth is enough for the project
compare each supplier with the same product, artwork, quantity direction and sales-channel brief
route paper boxes, rigid gift boxes, paper tubes, paper bags and corrugated packaging into a quote-ready brief
